translations.web: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.
translations.bsb: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
translations.kjv: But my horn shalt thou exalt like the horn of an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
translations.asv: But my horn hast thou exalted like the horn of the wild-ox: I am anointed with fresh oil.
